evidence.claim: Flagged txn 3530164 is $49.00 in-person, product W, region 330, country 87, risk 0.40, amount_vs_mean 0.38 and amount_z -0.49 - below the card's $128.84 mean and far below its $2,680.95 max.

Region 330 is not new for the card: 42 prior transactions in history and the card was used there on 2016-12-03, 12-07, 12-09 and 12-10; 95% of the card's 980 baseline transactions are in-person and 95% product W, matching the flagged charge exactly.

The cardholder's own acknowledged purchase 3530056 ($116.93, region 330, 2016-12-10 12:12) sits 49 minutes before the disputed charge in the same region, leaving no window for a separate clone to operate; 13 home-region transactions occurred within 48h.

Recurrence check shows 56 prior transactions at the same amount across 2016-07 through 2016-12 (e.g. 3487397, 3499168, 3511680, 3515518) with short day gaps - a habitual small-ticket amount for this card, though not strictly monthly (looks_monthly=false).

Customer C08623 maintains the denial but concedes being in region 330 and using the card there at ~12:12 that day, and reports no known $49.00 subscription - a denial of recollection rather than of presence.

The shared device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1440x900' appears on 33 cards all-time (5 in window), so it is not rare; none of the 22 episode transactions on this card carry any device, proxy or online channel (online_txns_in_episode=0), so the linked fraud cards (C06208-K1, C05600-K1, C09557-K1, C00854-K2) are not connected to this activity.

Prior confirmed fraud on this same card was card-present use in regions with no history (CC-2935, CC-4957, CC-2817, CC-3682) or mixed-channel takeover (CC-3327); the current charge shows neither a new region (new_region_for_card=false) nor any online/mixed-channel component. A prior alert on this card (CC-1589) was cleared after the cardholder confirmed activity.
Region 330 newcomer cluster is weak: fraud-history rate among newcomers 0.16 vs 0.10 base rate, and this card is not a newcomer to the region.
Policy R7 covers a disputed charge that matches the cardholder's own recurring pattern: create a case, verify and warn, do not block.

case.summary: Customer C08623 disputes a $49.00 card-present purchase (3530164) in region 330 on 2016-12-10. The charge is in the card's dominant channel and product, in a region with 42 prior transactions used on four days that week, for an amount the card has seen 56 times since July, and it occurred 49 minutes after a purchase the cardholder confirms making in the same region. On verification the cardholder maintained the denial but conceded being in region 330 and using the card there shortly before, which reads as failure to recognise a small routine charge rather than a third party's use. The shared IE/Trident device profile touches 33 cards all-time and none of this card's episode transactions carry a device, so the linked fraud cards do not connect to this activity. Prior confirmed fraud on this card was out-of-region or mixed-channel, neither of which is present. Assessment: legitimate at 0.35 - open a case for the dispute, warn the cardholder about the recurring small-ticket charge, keep the card monitored, no block and no report (exposure $49, no shared origin).

evidence_requests.assumed_response: The cardholder maintains they did not make the $49.00 charge; while they acknowledge being in region 330 that day and using the card there around 12:12, they say they do not recognise the 13:01 purchase and do not have any $49.00 subscription, fuel or transit arrangement they are aware of.

next_best_actions.what_changed: The verification reply kept the denial alive - which prevents a clean clear and nudges probability from 0.30 to 0.35 - but it also confirmed the cardholder was in region 330 and used the card there minutes earlier, which strengthens the legitimate reading of the 13:01 charge.

sar.reason: No report: activity assessed as legitimate (R3); §3a filing conditions do not apply.

stop_reason: Verification settled the question: customer_validation -> denies (policy §6). Verification has been obtained and the cardholder's own reply places them in the region using the card minutes earlier; with exposure of $49, no device or online footprint and no new-region signal, no further evidence request could plausibly move the verdict (policy:s6).
